content.overall_style: gentle watercolor storybook, soft pastel colors, warm lighting, charming classic illustration
content.voice_instructions: A gentle, warm, and comforting female narrator voice. Speak slowly and clearly as if reading a bedtime story to a young child. Pause naturally between sentences to allow the listener to follow the words on screen. The tone should start soft and compassionate, transitioning to quiet joy by the end.

cast.name: The Ugly Duckling
cast.appearance_prompt: A large, fluffy cygnet with dusty grey down feathers, a long neck, and gentle, sad dark eyes.

segments.image_prompt: A large, textured grey egg hatching in a warm nest of green burdock leaves, revealing a big, fluffy, grey cygnet looking around curiously.

lines.text: Deep in the green countryside, a giant egg finally cracked open.
Out tumbled a big, clumsy, grey duckling.

segments.image_prompt: A busy farmyard with yellow ducklings and a proud rooster turning their backs on a sad grey duckling who hangs his head.

lines.text: The other farm animals laughed at him.
They called him ugly and chased him away.

segments.image_prompt: The lonely grey duckling walking through tall, wild green reeds under a cloudy autumn sky, looking lost and small.

lines.text: Feeling very lonely, the poor duckling ran away into the wild marsh.

segments.image_prompt: A cold winter landscape with heavy snow falling, a small grey duckling shivering and huddled under a frozen, snow-capped log.

lines.text: Winter came with biting winds and deep, heavy snow.
The shivering duckling hid all alone under a frozen log.

segments.image_prompt: Golden spring sunshine melting thick blue ice on a pond, green grass shoots beginning to grow along the wet banks.

lines.text: At last, the warm spring sun began to melt the ice.

segments.image_prompt: Three majestic, graceful white swans with long elegant necks swimming together on a sparkling, sunlit pond.

lines.text: He saw three beautiful, elegant white swans gliding gracefully across the pond.

segments.image_prompt: The grey duckling swimming timidly toward the three majestic white swans, bowing his head down in shyness.

lines.text: The duckling swam toward them, bowing his head in sadness.

segments.image_prompt: A reflection in clear, blue water showing a stunningly beautiful white swan with elegant feathers, next to the ripples of the pond.

lines.text: But in the clear water, he saw his own reflection.
He was no longer a clumsy, dark grey bird.

segments.image_prompt: A beautiful white swan soaring happily into a bright blue spring sky, leaving the sparkling pond below.

lines.text: He had grown into a beautiful, magnificent white swan!
With a joyful heart, he flapped his strong wings and flew into the bright blue sky.
